comments.body:
For the main codebase, this change should amount to updating:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/pom.xml#L26

Then running:
mvn license:format

Please also ensure that the copyright dates are updated in the other projects in the fcrepo4 github organization:
https://github.com/fcrepo4
Please request travis ci rebuild after you back. Thanks
Yinlin Chen are you working on analogous changes for fcrepo-camel, fcrepo-message-consumer, fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl, fcrepo-module-auth-xacml, fcrepo-client, fcrepo-webapp-plus, fcrepo-oaiprovider?
Here's a PR for fcrepo-camel: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-camel/pull/50

Pending analogous updates to other projects in:
https://github.com/fcrepo4
I think that's all of them. Let me know if there are others.

PRs have been merged with their respective master branches:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/703
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-camel/pull/50
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-message-consumer/pull/71
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl/pull/10
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-module-auth-xacml/pull/30
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/pull/11
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-webapp-plus/pull/5

I missed one of the license year declarations in fcrepo-message-consumer. The relevant PR is here: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-message-consumer/pull/72
